meta.title: Contact the Frankencoin Association
meta.description: Write to the Frankencoin Association about integrations, listings, treasury use, media or anything else. One message is enough.

hero.title: Talk to|the Association
hero.subtitle: Integrations, listings, treasury questions, media requests. Tell us what you are building and we reply within a few working days.

form.title: Send a message
form.subtitle: The form goes to the Association's inbox. If you prefer email, write to info@frankencoin.com directly.
form.name: Your name
form.messagePlaceholder: What you are building, what you need from us, and any links.
form.consent: We use what you send only to answer you. No newsletter, no sharing.

form.errorValidation: Please fill in your name, a valid email and a message.
